narr: A weak upper level trough remained over south-central New Mexico and combined with near record atmospheric moisture levels resulting in heavy rain across much of Dona Ana County resulting in flash flooding from Las Cruces south to Santa Teresa.
ev: A truck needed to be rescued from flooded roads in Talavera.
